baseline.source: Batch6 exact live release manifest and public browser; prior three full independent Stay reviews in stay-iteration11 remain 81/90, 74.75/90 and 79/95 with full score null. Five Stay records had no displayed checked dates and location/direction data needed source review.
baseline.reason: Factual freshness across all 26 listings, direct assistive technology, field performance and visual deductions remain open. Scoped review cannot be converted into a 99/100 result.

triage.finding: Five Stay records lacked dated source checks; MP Beach Club pointed to Rye despite its operator locating it in Tootgarook. Arthurs Views was grouped under Dromana despite operator Arthurs Seat address.
triage.action: Check the five records against operator sources, update dated provenance and correct exact place/zone.

triage.finding: Four recorded map points were unsupported or inaccurate.
triage.action: Use the Arthurs Views operator map pin; omit unsourced MP Beach Club, Plantation House and Treetops coordinates so directions use sourced address or locality.

triage.finding: Operator wording conflicts on Arthurs Views suite count and Plantation House room count. Birch Creek booking metadata said Airbnb despite direct operator enquiry.
triage.action: Disclose count conflicts, correct direct enquiry route, preserve current operator facts without false certainty.

triage.finding: The newly corrected Tootgarook destination link used a 404 image path whose fallback showed unrelated scenery, with copy that overstated a pier and wetland access.
triage.action: Use a licensed accurately described local photo, source-backed Shire access and coast copy, and readable attribution.

hypothesis: Accurate dated venue facts, place grouping and directions improve visitor trust and route choices; correcting the linked Tootgarook page prevents a location fix from sending visitors to misleading imagery or access advice.
boundedChange: Five Stay venue JSON records and the linked Tootgarook guide, hero media and shared place hero credit display. No ranking, prices, booking transaction, consent or filter logic changes.
metric: Five venue source records pass content and coordinate checks; affected public detail pages show correct place and directions; Tootgarook shows actual local photo with adjacent CC BY-SA attribution; 320/390/1440 browser checks have no text overlap, overflow or page errors; exact deployed manifest and public pages confirm release.
rollback: Revert this bounded patch if public navigation, rights attribution or layout regresses; retain the source notes for any correction.
independentReview: Independent reviewer checked five operator records and the Commons/Shire sources; flagged unsupported signed-path wording and 320px hero-credit overlap. Final exact built preview passed independent Tootgarook checks at 320/390/1440. The same reviewer confirmed live batch6 Flinders hub attribution after expanding editorial choices. This is scoped QA, not a full rubric score.
